title: Sample Transfer and Bead Mastermix Addition
author: Opentrons
materials: Master Mix Distribution and Sample Transfer](./022548-

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters before running the protocol: number of samples in tuberack 1 slot 10‑11 (1‑32), tuberack 2 slot 7‑8 (0‑32), tuberack 3 slot 4‑5 (0‑32); master‑mix wells location (e.g., 1‑4 for wells A1‑A4, can be a single well); master‑mix maximum volume per well = 9.54 mL; master‑mix mixing‑rate multiplier (default 1.0, lower = slower, higher = faster); master‑mix aspiration flow‑rate multiplier; master‑mix dispension flow‑rate multiplier; mount for the 300 µL single‑channel pipette (left or right); mount for the 300 µL multi‑channel pipette (left or right); optional pause after mixing the master‑mix for manual vortex/nutation/shaking if pipette mixing is insufficient.

steps.title: Transfer samples to destination plate
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel 300 µL pipette mounted as specified, attach 200 µL filter tips and transfer samples from the up‑to‑three PRL tuberacks to the destination plate in row order, dispensing each sample into its corresponding well.

steps.title: Resuspend bead/binding buffer master‑mix
steps.instruction: Mix the bead/binding‑buffer master‑mix by pipetting up and down 7 times. If the optional pause parameter is set, pause after mixing to allow manual vortexing, nutation or shaking before proceeding.

steps.title: Distribute master‑mix to samples
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel 300 µL pipette mounted as specified and regular 300 µL tips, dispense the prepared master‑mix into the wells of the destination plate that contain the transferred samples.
